description: Rows of battered lockers stand beneath a duty roster scrawled in several different, increasingly irritated handwritings. Someone has pinned up a wanted poster that is unmistakably a self-portrait.

items.name: a much-amended duty roster
items.description: Several names have been crossed out and replaced with the word 'promoted', suspiciously often.

doorways.description: A door marked CAPTAIN. KNOCK. THIS MEANS YOU.
A short corridor lined with iron bars.
A reinforced door, slightly dented from the inside.
